name: A view out from a sheltered place is preferred

range.to: wide view from a sheltered edge

claim: A meta-analysis of preference studies found support for prospect in urban and interior scenes, and weaker, mixed support for refuge.
caveat: The authors call the quantitative evidence inconsistent; we did not read the full paper or its study counts.

sources.title: Dosen and Ostwald 2016, Evidence for prospect-refuge theory: a meta-analysis of the findings of environmental preference research, City, Territory and Architecture 3
